record.bible_text: <FO><FO><FI> A Psalm<Fi> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Unto thee will I cry<WH07121><WTH8799>, O LORD<WH03068> my rock<WH06697>; be not silent<WH02814><WTH8799> to me: lest, <FI>if<Fi> thou be silent<WH02790><WTH8799> to me, I become<WH04911><WTH8738> like them that go down<WH03381><WTH8802> into the pit<WH0953>. <RF>to me: Heb. from me<Rf>

Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> the voice<WH06963> of my supplications<WH08469>, when I cry<WH07768><WTH8763> unto thee, when I lift up<WH05375><WTH8800> my hands<WH03027> toward thy holy<WH06944> oracle<WH01687>. <RF>thy...: or, the oracle of thy sanctuary<Rf>

Draw me not away<WH04900><WTH8799> with the wicked<WH07563>, and with the workers<WH06466><WTH8802> of iniquity<WH0205>, which speak<WH01696><WTH8802> peace<WH07965> to their neighbours<WH07453>, but mischief<WH07451> <FI>is<Fi> in their hearts<WH03824>.

Give<WH05414><WTH8798> them according to their deeds<WH06467>, and according to the wickedness<WH07455> of their endeavours<WH04611>: give<WH05414><WTH8798> them after the work<WH04639> of their hands<WH03027>; render<WH07725><WTH8685> to them their desert<WH01576>.

Because they regard<WH0995><WTH8799> not the works<WH06468> of the LORD<WH03068>, nor the operation<WH04639> of his hands<WH03027>, he shall destroy<WH02040><WTH8799> them, and not build them up<WH01129><WTH8799>.<CM>
Blessed<WH01288><WTH8803> <FI>be<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>, because he hath heard<WH08085><WTH8804> the voice<WH06963> of my supplications<WH08469>.

The LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> my strength<WH05797> and my shield<WH04043>; my heart<WH03820> trusted<WH0982><WTH8804> in him, and I am helped<WH05826><WTH8738>: therefore my heart<WH03820> greatly rejoiceth<WH05937><WTH8799>; and with my song<WH07892> will I praise<WH03034><WTH8686> him.

The LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> their strength<WH05797>, and he <FI>is<Fi> the saving<WH03444> strength<WH04581> of his anointed<WH04899>. <RF>their: or, his<Rf> <RF>saving...: Heb. strength of salvations<Rf>
